[SWS_DM_02167] Retrieval of SOVD entity operations
⌈
If the SOVD method Query for operations from an Entity is received, the
DM shall send a response body according to ASAM SOVD[5][14] and add for each
available DiagnosticSovdOperation a SOVD OperationDescription item
with the attributes:
id set to the shortName of the DiagnosticSovdOperation [SWS_DM_01402],
name set to the longName of the DiagnosticSovdOperation [SWS_DM_01401],
proximity_proof_required set
to
DiagnosticSovdOperation.proximi-
tyProofRequired [SWS_DM_01400],
asynchronous_execution set to FALSE, if DiagnosticSovdOperationPrim-
itive only aggregates a DiagnosticSovdOperationStart (DiagnosticSov-
dOperation.start), otherwise it is set to TRUE [SWS_DM_01399].
⌋
